shots.prompt: {moss} waters tomato plants with a small red watering can on a rooftop garden, the camera orbits fast around him. Golden evening light.
Close-up: {moss} laughs out loud in a cosy kitchen, the camera pushes in fast. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} rides a red bicycle down a street of crooked clay houses past a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses who waves, the camera tracks beside him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} seen from behind walks down a wooden pier toward a little red canoe on a green canal, the camera cranes up. Golden morning light.
{moss} sits at a wooden table eating soup with a big spoon in a cosy kitchen, steam rising, crash zoom on his happy face. Warm afternoon light.

{moss} dances at a rooftop party at night under string lights beside a woman in a red dress with a tall black bun and a man in a blue jumper with a ginger beard. The camera whip-pans. Warm lantern light.
